data.raw_text: Definitely getting concerned about the storm surge threat in Baler Bay. Huge waves from Typhoon Fung-wong (UwanPH) are already crashing into the Aurora coastline of Luzon, and if the storm makes landfall just south of the bay, it could push a dangerous flow of seawater directly into Baler. Widespread reports are also indicating that substantial freshwater flash flooding is ongoing in multiple locations. Conditions across the northern Philippines will only continue to get worse from here on out.

data.raw_text:
Bukas ang mga evacuation center ng mga barangay ng Quezon City para sa QCitizens na apektado ng Bagyong #UwanPH. 

Namahagi na ang Social Services Development Department (SSDD) ng hot meals habang inihanda na ng City Health Department (QCHD) ang doxycycline at tetanus toxoid sa mga evacuees.

Paalala mula sa QCHD: Kung lumusong sa tubig-baha, magtungo agad sa pinakamalapit na health center para makakuha ng doxycycline bilang proteksyon laban sa leptospirosis.

Mag-ingat lagi, QCitizens!

Paalala mula sa QCHD: Kung lumusong sa tubig-flood, magtungo agad sa pinakamalapit na health center para makakuha ng doxycycline bilang proteksyon laban sa leptospirosis. Mag-ingat lagi, QCitizens!
data.english_translation: Tomorrow is the evacutation centers of the Quezon City males for the QCitizens affected by Hurricane #UwanPH. The Social Services Development Department (SSDD) of hot meals while the City Health Department (QCHD) has prepared the doxycycline and tetanus toxoids to evacuees. Remember from QD: If waded into water, go immediately to the nearest health center for doxucline procopes.

data.raw_text: Crazy footage below of fierce, near-whiteout winds and severe flooding in the city of Virac on Catanduanes. The island became fully consumed in the Category 3 eyewall of Typhoon Fung-wong (UwanPH) over the last few hours as the marauding storm passed by to the north. Calabarzon and the Aurora coast of Luzon are now in line for Fung-wong’s ultimate, direct landfall into the Philippines.

#MSNews | Personnel of the Catbalogan City Fire Station retrieved a cadaver trapped beneath the debris of her destroyed residence at Pier 2, Barangay 3, Catbalogan City, following the devastation brought by Super Typhoon "Uwan."

Upon receiving the report, BFP Catbalogan immediately dispatched a response team to the area to conduct search and retrieval operations.

"We continue to stand in solidarity with all those affected by the recent typhoon and remain committed to providing assistance and emergency response to our fellow Catbalogans in this time of crisis," the Catbalogan Fire Station said in their statement. | via Vince Lopez

📷 Catbalogan City Fire Station

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSgGa.
